senses.gloss:
मेद मेद, m.
 1. Adeps, fat.
 2. The son of a Vaideha by a Kārāvara female, Man. 10, 36.

मेदस् मेदस्, n.
 1. Marrow, Pañc. i. d. 123.
 2. The serous secretion that spreads amongst the muscular fibres.
 3. Morbid corpulency, Śāk. d. 38.
 --Cf. perhaps Lat. medulla.

मेदिनी मेदिनी (probably = मृदिनी, and based on its original form मर्दिनी, cf. गेह, वेतन; or perhaps मेद + इन् + ई), f.
 1. The earth, Pañc. iii. d. 41; earth, Johns. Sel. 95, 67.
 2. A country, Cāṇ. 45 in Berl. Monatsb. 1864, 410.

मेदुर मेदुर (cf. मेदस्), adj.
 1. Unctuous.
 2. Smooth.
 3. Soft.
 4. Thick, Utt. Rāmac. 143, 2.
मेदुरित मेदुरित, i. e. मेदुर + इत, adj. Unctuous, abounding in water, Utt. Rāmac. 16, 10.
